title: A windmill lighting a bulb
question: How steady is the light when the wind gusts, and how much steadier does a small battery make it?
line: A small wind turbine (1.5 m across) on a hillside drives a permanent-magnet generator wired to a 12 V, 60 W filament bulb. The wind gusts and drops at random. The rotor's inertia smooths out quick gus
